about: #641 AI-reviewer agreement check, Nov 11 2026. The reference grades were supplied by ChatGPT (pasted in chat by Paige), NOT by Paige: this measures grader v8's agreement with another AI reviewer, and human calibration is still pending. Grader v8 run 43108154514 (12 calls, $0.2859). calibration_report against the ChatGPT reference: fails (gates meet agreement; one missed fail, r5 faithfulness 1 vs 3; directness, hedging and concision miss the bar). Kept as regression examples for the next grader version. Nov 11: grader v9 re-graded the same 12 (run 43120040958, 12 calls, $0.3050) as a before/after on the tuning set; it is not validation.
